decisions: Single click selects, Ctrl/Shift multi-select, double-click/Enter opens directly into preview. Preserve multi-tabs and confirm only whole-overlay multi-tab closure. Keep album/page favorite actions distinct and information reachable.

Integrate the independently prepared continuation candidate only after baseline/hash review. Preserve exact HTTPS hosts, same-session generation, native kind/path/query/scope checks, known-only options, cancellation and resource bounds. Unknown request context equivalence remains actual-verification-required, not proven by HTTP success.
Only explicit terminal evidence means end. Missing, invalid, echoed or rejected continuation means limited; retain old cards/selection/scroll on follow-up failure.

Add an own-boards switch within Favorites; never replace local album/page favorites. Resolve current owner from authenticated official session projection only, never arbitrary recommended users or guessed account names. Keep owner path and remote lists in session memory; reject absent/conflicting ownership. No cookie export or remote board writes.

X mockups are synthetic local interactions, not connected feeds. Recommend a text/media balanced single-column baseline, plus gallery, multi-column, list-preview and creator-grouped alternatives. An external-site wrapper alone does not satisfy native feed browsing; report the unimplemented connection boundary explicitly if credentials/actual integration cannot be completed.
